title: Collatz: quantitative unit escape, exact pressure and Lean descent
body:
## Problem and new result

Actual tripling disagreements and the interior two-class remainder still have no complete closing bound. This revision gives a quantitative escape from nonunits to **ordinary unit defects with the same ordered labels**, a finer residue escape with one exact strict descent, and summable estimates for specified portions of the original source graph. **Collatz remains open.**

Three GPT-6.2 Astra streams developed the attacks. The coordinator reconstructed the complete new arguments, ran both exact finite certificates and the fresh Lean executions, and checked this exact published commit in a clean complete checkout.

**Scientific packet:** [Quantitative unit escape and the remaining two-class geometry](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/README.md).

**Evidence:** [execution and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/README.md) · [source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/SOURCES.json) · [coordinator reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/ROOT_REVIEW.md).

This checkpoint starts from `2c1397d2adcadc620381bca20c465f3bf31a6f8e`. It changes **42 files: 40 additions and two navigation updates**. Previous proof packets remain intact. The [preceding complete PR description and receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/PRIOR_PR_DESCRIPTION.md) are archived with the stated whitespace normalization.

## 1. An actual unit escape with an explicit exponent

For an invariant binary label, call an odd x a defect when f(x) differs from f(3x). A unit is coprime to three. For 1<=Z<=X, the octave count satisfies

`D([X,2X)) <= D_unit(CXZ) + O(X Z^(-2001/5000) / sqrt(log(2X)))`.

The unit witnesses preserve the **ordered** labels and are injective within each original octave, even across different exit depths. The square root uses the pinned source-qualified native pair estimate P. Omitting that factor gives a theorem using the new arithmetic and finite certificate alone. Permanently nonunit continuations have at most **O(X^(1/5))** ordinary starting integers through X, without P or a density premise.

The exact chain is

`f(3s)=f(16s+1), f(3(16s+1))=f(32s+1), f(3(32s+1))=f(9s)`.

Opposite outer binary labels select exactly one changing successor. Ternary integrality restricts the initial source, while each letter fixes additional binary digits of its successor. A counted shadow merger rejects the corresponding word at **every contiguous occurrence**. Two decoders reconstruct the same length-22 dictionary: **4,218 states and 5,349 overlaps**. Exact 512-step unweighted and 86-step weighted row bounds give the all-length census and pressure. The graph enumeration is Python evidence; its shadow soundness has a Lean proof.

With Z=(log X)^(5/4), the normalized discarded octave weight is O((log X)^(-4001/4000)), summable. Therefore

`sum_unit-defects (log(2y))^(5/4)/y < infinity => sum_all-odd-defects 1/x < infinity`.

The previous exact route carries those units to the literal suffix **57** in any fixed open head arc and fixed level schedule, with bounded scale change and multiplicity. Under the separately qualified fixed-target density input M, convergence of that weighted restricted series would prove Collatz. Its convergence is not proved here.

[Escape theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/UNIT_EXIT.md) · [exact checker](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/check_nonunit.py) · [Lean arithmetic](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/NonunitExit.lean).

## 2. Both directed patterns are necessary on suffix 57

Using the published Krasikov–Lagarias predecessor exponent .84, the PR 146 actual-label variation argument and its bounded directed returns, a counterexample would force **each orientation separately** to have

`limsup D_unit,+/- (Y) / Y^(42021/70025) > 0`,

where 42021/70025 is approximately .600086. This power conclusion uses no M and no native square root. With P, the simpler denominator Y^(3/5)(log Y)^(3/4) also works.

Both conclusions transfer to each corresponding parent–child color pattern on the prescribed suffix-57 schedule along unbounded sequences of rows. Thus proving either one-way basin implication eventually on that schedule would settle Collatz. That implication is still open.

[Oriented statement and exact source pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/ORIENTED_UNIT_SUFFIX.md).

## 3. A finer unit class and one kernel-checked strict descent

A second three-letter process starts in x=1 mod16 and stops at **17 mod48**. Its separate exact certificate has **12,969 states and 35,778 overlaps** and proves, for 1<=Z<=X^(1/10),

`D_1([X,2X)) <= 3 D_17([X,CXZ]) + O(X Z^(-200/3599)/sqrt(log(2X)))`.

The route preserves ordered labels; at most three sources from an octave share a witness. The permanently unescaped input count is O(X^.93). Since 200/3599>1/18, taking Z=(log X)^9 makes the original exception summable.

The older aggregate reduction of all odd defects to 1 mod16 then makes the logarithmic ninth-moment on 17 mod48 a sufficient condition under M. An arbitrary fixed power saving in that residue's defect count would also suffice under M. The aggregate older reduction is not assumed to preserve a prescribed orientation, and .93 does not beat the classical .84 threshold.

Every target has an exact smaller representative:

`48t+17 -> 32t+11`,

with both f(x) and f(3x) preserved in order. **Lean checked this for every parameter t.** It gives one strict descent; a route iterating the descent is missing.

[Second escape](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/RESIDUE17_ESCAPE.md) · [second checker](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/check_residue17.py) · [Lean exchanges](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/UnitResidueExchange.lean).

## 4. Summable ordinary-source pieces of the two-head graph

For R=81^j and d=log_2 R, compare two actual regenerated heads by advancing the earlier pair through their relative physical clock. Their four rays share one ordinary affine parameter.

When the entering grade intervals are disjoint and only two symbolic classes remain at an intermediate deadline, both original heads occupy both classes. A live cross pair must reverse its grade order and pass through a grade tie. Stopping at the first tie permits a product of native survival bounds. There are at most two exponent choices at each positive initial interval distance, so the full exponent sum costs a harmonic sum.

The tested graph has weighted degree

`Gamma_tested <= O(d (log d)^2)`.

Two comparisons in disjoint future-bit windows give original normalized multiplicity **O(d^(-3/2)(log d)^(9/2))**, which is summable. This also covers overlapping intervals when the older pair reverses its own weak grade order. Predictable moving-endpoint tracks rule out concentration of a positive frequency of witnesses inside sufficiently small neighborhoods of width c sqrt(D/log d).

At mesoscopic lags V<=v<=2V, V=floor(d^alpha), the uniform triple input U1 removes a positive density of nearby-grade comparisons with at least three symbolic classes surviving a further d/10 bits. The all-head first-moment bound is summable for **alpha<1/3**. Repeated tests on **one original coarse coordinate** extend the positive-density conclusion for **distinct time pairs** to every **alpha<2/3**. Multiple heads at one pair of clocks count once in that extension.

The persistent interior, order-preserving two-class case remains. No full graph summability is claimed.

[Four-ray proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/DISJOINT_GRADE_CROSSINGS.md) · [nested refinements](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/NESTED_GRADE_REFINEMENTS.md) · [repeated mesoscopic tests](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/REPEATED_MESOSCOPIC_TRIPLES.md).

## 5. Information in actual ordinary color answers

After revealing the native source residue, the full exterior high quotient of the coarse coordinate, and polynomially many possible physical arm seeds, current ordinary trit-color queries still must reveal information about the next fixed block of coarse bits. On a contiguous late interval of D>=(log d)^6 clocks, for a retained original source fraction w,

`sum_t I(current replies; next h bits | public prefix) >= gamma D - h log(C d^C/w)`.

The selection uses O(log d) current color queries and returns a genuine discordant head in the prescribed open arc at every regeneration clock. The proof compares to a law rerandomizing just that next block, with the entropy deficit charged at most h times. It proves a lower bound; no incompatible upper bound is known.

Recent PR 201 antichains and PR 203 inverse-depth populations were read and compared at their exact new heads. They concern larger real windows under their source-qualified atom-floor inputs and do not give the missing conditional information bound in our selected power-short cell. Existing antichain results are credited as prior work.

[Information theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/LOCAL_COLOR_INFORMATION.md) · [current-source comparison](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/MIXED_ADIC_SCOPE.md).

## Formal execution and exact finite evidence

All four new Lean modules were freshly compiled with Lean **4.34.1**, Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`, one worker, disabled auto-implicit arguments and warnings as errors.

| Module | New public theorems | Kernel-checked content |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| NonunitExit | 5 | Ordered physical chain, binary successor and rational-shadow soundness |
| DisjointGradeCrossing | 2 | Reversed class selection and compulsory grade tie |
| PredictablePhysicalArms | 6 | One-bit-lag transport, trit truncation and signed current |
| UnitResidueExchange | 2 | Ordered unit exchange and strict residue-17 descent |

The main three-module build exited 0 in **217.172 seconds**; the separate residue module exited 0 in **1.547 seconds**. Both had empty stderr. All **15** public theorems have only subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound` as transitive axioms.

The coordinator's nonunit and residue finite replays exited 0 in **1.982** and **1.053 seconds**, respectively, with empty stderr. Each rebuilt both decoders, the entire fixed-width dictionary and all stated integer row iterations. No old expensive searches were rerun.

[All public axioms](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/axiom-audit.json) · [main Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/lean-build.json) · [residue Lean receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/residue17-lean-build.json) · [nonunit finite receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/finite-certificate.json) · [residue finite receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/residue17-finite-certificate.json) · [source hashes](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/source-hashes.json) · [final integrated review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/unit-exit/INTEGRATED_WORDING_REVIEW.md).

The pressure graph enumerations, probability, information and infinite-series assembly remain **written proofs**, with the exact external P, R, U1 and M qualifications stated where used. Neither a full analytic formalization nor a terminating interpretation of the complete Yolcu–Aaronson–Heule rewrite system is claimed.

## Remaining closing step

A summable bound for the actual unit-defect moment, a route that continues the residue-17 strict descent, or a sufficiently strong bound on the interior order-preserving two-class graph would be new decisive input. The current color-information lower bound offers another precise target for such an estimate. This revision does not discharge those obligations.
